description: Guard (016 T014n, round-5 review F1, n2). A div tag line opens a pre element that closes on the next line; the div block runs on to the blank line, and the opener after the pre has no closer before it. Raw HTML passes through, so the browser's comment hides the marker after it. The digest on disk carries only the visible rule, so the check must say OK; harvesting the hidden marker would call this correct digest stale. c6d95a1 gave the tag line the element's end but forgot the block the line itself starts, so when the element closed the opener was disarmed and the marker harvested. Since 016 phase 2 (plan D8 and D11 as amended during phase 2) the marker passed over inside the comment is also reported by DIGEST-020, so the run fails naming its line; a mutation that harvests it drops that report and reads the digest stale.
